emma (People Ops): Morning all — quick upload plan for SOC2/ISO evidence. I created a shared Dropbox folder with subfolders by control owner: https://dropbox.com/s/abcd1234/redwood-evidence. Please upload artifacts to your team folder by EOD Friday (6:00pm PT).

Please DO NOT upload raw production PII/PHI or unredacted logs. If you must include logs, sanitize and prefix filenames with `redacted_`. There's a `README.md` in the folder with a short checklist (file names expected, sample formats).

luca (Eng Manager): Are the backup config snapshots required for infra? And what level of detail do you want for retention policy docs?

sabrina (Security Eng): Yes on backups — infra should include configs + a one-paragraph retention statement. Also: if you need encrypted uploads, use `secure_upload.sh` in the repo (linked in README). If a file is sensitive, add the `__SENSITIVE__` token to the filename so reviewers handle it correctly.

jin (Contractor): Quick Q — onboarding screenshots (login flows) — small PNGs ok? Where to put them?

emma (People Ops): Put them under `/onboarding-snapshots/<team>/` and name like `jin-2026-03-xx.png`. We'll move anything acceptable to S3 after review. If screenshots contain user data, redact first.

reminder-bot: :alarm_clock: Heads-up: 48 hours until the upload window closes for squads A-D.

luca (Eng Manager): Uploaded infra/bkp-configs.tar.gz to `infra/backup-configs/` :thumbsup:

sabrina (Security Eng): Updated the README with exact filename patterns and an example for `retention_policy.md`. Also linked JIRA INF-4321 for the infra evidence sweep.

emma (People Ops): One last ask — managers, please confirm in this thread by 5:00pm PT today whether your team's artifacts are complete or note blockers. We'll compile and hand off to audits.

luca (Eng Manager): Confirming for infra — all items uploaded and checklist ticked.

jin (Contractor): Uploading now, will comment here when finished.

sabrina (Security Eng): Blocking: I have one raw log that needs redaction and I need someone from ops to help scrub timestamps. @maria can you take this?

maria (Ops): On it — can help with redaction tooling and will DM for SFTP details.

emma (People Ops): Thanks all. If anyone hits a hard blocker, mention me and I'll escalate to compliance. We'll send a summary doc after the review. :sparkles:
